name: dispatch_social_broadcast
description: Triggers or previews a multi-platform broadcast (Telegram & Discord) for a given date with native .mp4 video attachments.

target_date.title: Target Date
target_date.description: Target date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today if omitted.

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: If True, generates captions and previews without sending. Set False to execute live broadcast.
